scope: Additive official confirmation of Hero Banner assignment. It strengthens only the existing scenario-selected Banner variant and does not add an unmeasured patrol or defensive combat contract.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: Up to four Hero Banners can be placed in the Village.
A player selects the Hero image on a Banner to swap the defending Hero for that area.
Defending Heroes patrol around their Banner and defend it from enemy attacks.
sources.limitations: The support article supplies no patrol radius or path, target selection, engagement distance, return rule, respawn rule, collision geometry, attack timing or same-tick ordering.

assignment_contract.implemented: The immutable non-combat scenario carries an explicit Hero Banner variant selected by the caller. The same value is used by Core geometry, Headless scenario I/O, Viewer artwork and replay serialization.
assignment_contract.not_implemented: A selected variant is not a materialized defending Hero and cannot alter logical combat.

conclusion: The official assignment interaction corroborates the existing explicit Banner variant. Defensive Hero combat remains partial because the source does not define a deterministic contract.
